senses.gloss:
Buppadevabhaṭṭa
or Vuppa Bhaṭṭa. a resident of Karambapura; preceptor of Rāma Bhaṭṭa (a. of C. on Āśvalāyana [Page037-b] gṛhyakārikā of Kumārilasvāmin, Bomb. Uni. 906).
See NCC. II. p. 215b.

Buppārāhula
--Mantrasam3keta. Kas. Śaivism; Kaula. Ref. to by Jayaratha in C. on Vāmakeśvarīmata, Kas. texts LXVI. p. 125.
